tools.name: get_public_preprint
tools.description: Read one exact, completed public preprint disclosure. A preprint is separate from journal acceptance; DOI registration, preservation and scientific verification are not inferred.

tools.name: get_public_review_index
tools.description: Read the index and exact section counts of one frozen, published review disclosure. Review, DOI, preservation and publication have separate states.

tools.name: get_public_review_item_bytes
tools.description: Read at most 32 KiB of one exact frozen public-review item, including a section or child item too large for a page. Follow next_action, match disclosure/version/section/parent/ordinal/item identity and digest across chunks, then verify SHA-256 of the assembled canonical JSON bytes before parsing. Th

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Read one catalogued public resource by its identifier, including its recorded rights and provenance.

tools.name: get_starter_source
tools.description: Download one original licensed starter ZIP as base64 with its SHA-256 and rights. Source has not run or been verified; submitting it still requires isolated ingestion.

tools.name: get_starter_study
tools.description: Read one licensed starter study's frozen inputs, archive digest, environment, expected interpretation and unrun status.

tools.name: get_task_template
tools.description: Read one frozen task template in full: its question, inputs, assumptions, comparison basis, stated limitations and revision digest. The digest pins the exact revision an attempt was prepared against.

tools.name: list_public_review_coverage_page
tools.description: Read one bounded page of a published review's frozen literature-coverage declarations. A declaration is not independent evidence of every cited passage.

tools.name: list_public_review_finding_events_page
tools.description: Read one bounded page of a published finding's frozen public events. Private or later responses are not included.

tools.name: list_public_review_section_page
tools.description: Read one bounded section of a frozen published review disclosure. Finding events and literature coverage have separate child pages; follow next_action for complete history.

tools.name: list_starter_studies
tools.description: List original downloadable source studies with explicit licenses, archive digests, pinned catalog environments and unrun evidence status.

tools.name: list_task_templates
tools.description: List the bounded, frozen questions this platform publishes for attempt. Each carries a revision digest and its own stated limitations.

tools.name: platform_status
tools.description: Report the current stage and, for every capability, whether it is available and the stated reason. Several capabilities are gated; this tool is the authoritative answer on which.

tools.name: search_public_preprints
tools.description: Search only completed, currently accessible public preprint snapshots. Each result names an exact version and remains separate from journal articles, DOI registration, preservation and scientific verification.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search public dataset, software, article, method and experiment listing metadata by title, summary, question, comparison, use case, source identity, rights and limits. Results retain source revision and readiness; they are not scientific evidence.
